contract: Real Beeper Desktop API client uses existing credential references, bounded cached conversation/message pages and media identities. Revision-guarded disconnect clears the credential reference and provider cache while preserving audit outbox rows and invalidating their connection revision. Durable outbox stores drafts before approval-gated send, binds to connection revision, atomically claims once, distinguishes pending/bridge confirmation/unknown and never automatically resends. HTTP/native/Console operations include recovery and discard. Local checks never send external messages.
acceptance: Persistent connection revisions, cache isolation, bounded documented Beeper page metadata
Durable idempotent draft/CAS/restart/interrupted-send recovery without automatic retry
Actual HTTP/native/Console draft and unavailable-credential journeys
Real documented Beeper read/send/reconcile/asset client source with outbound approval metadata
Explicit external successful fetch/send/attachment qualifications remain pending actual Beeper connection
Explicit disconnect clears cached provider state and prevents old drafts from sending
limits: Actual Beeper successful page fetch, attachment bytes, send acknowledgement and bridge confirmation are unqualified without a running credentialed Desktop.
No outbound external messages sent by qualification.
Cached pages represent available pages only, not complete network history.
Local mirror helper dead test helper removed per root compile finding; no unchanged .04 rerun.
The native source uses explicit manual refresh; no background Beeper socket or poller is claimed.
